description: This file manages the Redux state slice for 'boards' in a web application, including actions, reducers, selectors, and async thunks for handling board data, members, templates, and user memberships.

methods.name: fetchBoardMembers
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches members of a specified board and updates the store with user data.

methods.name: updateMembersEnsuringBoardsAndUsers
methods.description: Ensures that board memberships and user data are loaded and up-to-date, dispatching relevant actions.

methods.name: updateMembersHandler
methods.description: Updates the state with new board members, adding or removing as necessary.

methods.name: getBoard
methods.description: Returns a selector function to retrieve a specific board or template by ID.

methods.name: getMyBoardMembership
methods.description: Returns a selector function to retrieve the current user's membership info for a specific board.
